summary.zh: 安全作业口径、红队 runbook 与交付纪律
summary.en: Security-ops rules, red-team runbooks and delivery discipline

description.zh: 在会话中注入安全作业口径与红队 runbook，覆盖侦察、漏洞验证、凭据测试、隧道与内网横向。命中安全类请求时附带对应 runbook 原文；模型拒答时补一条可直接执行的内容。仅用于自有或受托资产的授权测试。
description.en: Inject security-ops rules and red-team runbooks into the session, covering recon, vulnerability verification, credential testing, tunnels and lateral movement. Matched requests carry the original runbook; when the model refuses, a directly usable fallback is posted. For authorized testing of owned or entrusted assets only.
